time_conditional.kind: frozen original V2 full native C6/C7, actual core bound by separate TC shim

ar_rollout_training.kind: separate native scalar response-head adaptation C6/C7

one_step_teacher_forcing.kind: separate native scalar response-head adaptation C6/C7; validation/final free rollout

original_C3_evidence: Original coupon C3 training, support/failure probes and source bytes remain immutable. V3 train-only functional probes use original C3 shared-state references for position equivalence; these are not large-domain C3 full fits.
budget_decision: After all six train-only functional probes and all six distinct-case stream profiles, root selects one common bounded cap. A separate fit protocol hashes all 12 JSON receipts and the resource protocol before any fit can start. Neither 180 nor 300 seconds is a target in itself.
resource_measurement: Functional probes verify model behavior and three joint updates. Separate profiles execute five distinct train cases with batch1, bitwise input comparison outside measured phases, separate CPU preparation/H2D/synchronized compute timings and recorded cold/warm samples. Whole-epoch and minimum-work projections are labeled estimates.

minimum_actual_training_exposure.scope: all executed run work; selected validation checkpoint exposure is separately reported and can be earlier

native_field_scope: Phone: native GPS VM scalar, projected total-strain Frobenius and EPSP. Bumper: native upper/lower in-plane VM scalars and EPSP; no native total-strain label. Stress is not tensor3 and displacement-derived strain is not substituted.
final_gate: Only after minimum executed exposure, fixed complete-epoch validation selection, SHA freeze, fresh-process validation reload. Final held-out free rollout exactly once; subsequent metrics only saved final NPZ. Selected and all-executed/partial exposure separated and bound to selection freeze.

selected_checkpoint_policy.earlier_selected_exposure: Report separately as a quality/convergence limitation; it does not block a single final if terminal executed minimum is met.
selected_checkpoint_policy.epoch0_zero_update_policy: Untrained attempt/failure or training-validation baseline only; no held-out final test and no learned-predictor claim.

failed_fit_recovery: If actual terminal work misses 100 updates or two complete case epochs, preserve the attempt as a failed training-exposure gate and do not evaluate held-out test. No automatic retry or extra fit is authorized by this protocol. Root may explicitly direct a separately versioned profile/protocol using training-resource/validation evidence only; any additional actual fit count/cost must be disclosed. Existing artifacts are never overwritten and a functional probe does not complete the failed full-training objective.
